description: This file implements the CountryService interface, providing methods for managing country data, including retrieval by code, adding descriptions, and fetching country lists with caching. It is a core component managing country-related business logic within a sales management application.

classes.name: CountryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of business logic for managing country data, extending a generic service, with methods for CRUD operations, caching, and linking country descriptions.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Country entity by its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Associates a CountryDescription with a Country and updates it.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of country ISO codes to Country objects for a specific language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries matching provided ISO codes for a specific language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches all countries for a given language, utilizing caching.
